flags.observation: No style text with variants A and B, genre or BPM accompanies the candidate; danceability and genre rotation cannot be verified.
"a thriller has to meet a fact-check" lets an abstraction act like a person; reads as a generic aphorism more than the deck's thesis.
Intro has only two beats and no onboarding: no speaker, no statement of what this track does or of the satirical premise.
Stand-up setup with the neighbour at three a.m. gets no punch; the second sentence is earnest, and the dog whistles are only card names.
Outside card text the stem forward- appears three times (forwards, forwarded, forwarding) across beats 2 and 6.
Opener "Instant." merely echoes "instantly" in the same line; no therefore/but link from Smart Dust.
"After the Twitter Files:" is temporal sequencing, an and-then link; no causal or twist tie to the lockdown card.
"Hat." is a one-word label echoing the card's own hat; no bridge from Vatican Secret Archives before it.
"Buried." repeats "buried" from the same line; no causal or twist link from The Akashic Records.
"Aircraft." is a bare label with no link to Operation Highjump; openers rarely sell a card as a character with a want.
"Unplug." echoes "unplugged" in the line; a signpost, not a bridge from The Satire Sanity Shield.
Outro calls back to the merch card, not to an intro image such as the neighbour or the forwarded meme.
"independent thought suspicious; disinformation." ends on a dangling noun; the labeling mechanic is lost and the clause reads unexplained.
"billionaire dream escapes death" makes the dream the actor; card states the dream is to escape death, and "peasantry" is dropped.
Card says "whoever holds the DARPA contract"; the line "report to DARPA" shifts the claim's target.
"like a side of beef, stops thinking" has no verb or subject; with "irradiates you" cut, the image does not parse.
"false choice" is the power label recited as a closing tag.
"accused of secret society" is garbled grammar, and "holy espionage" is the power label appended as a list item.
"cosmic church politics" fuses "cosmic politics" and "the church tried to bury" into a new claim.
"Admiral Byrd south" is verbless; the card's "never poke the ice wall again" punch shrinks to "treaty and an ice wall".
"OSS stole black-budget spark" merges two card sentences; the spark that ignited aerospace supremacy becomes the stolen object.
Card's ironic frame "you're just a crazy conspiracy theorist" is cut; "solar energy blocked" from the power now reads as flat assertion.
"accessorize history ironically" loses its motive once "If they won't declassify history" is cut; the line feels clipped.
